Abandon closes the dream you dream without reviewing anything: its items
wait for the next dream, and every memory directory it wrote is put back as
it found it, from the snapshot taken before its first write. The reason, if
given, goes in its diary. Only a dream's own agent runs it; agent dream run
does the same for a dream whose agent is gone.

Usage:
  agent dream abandon ["why"] [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream abandon "the transcripts were too large to read in one pass"

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for abandon

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
